Good questions

Questions from Saint John

Which parts of Saint John do you cover?

All of Saint John, including Uptown, East Side, West Side, North End, South End, Millidgeville and Lakewood. Just outside Saint John? Text me at 506-799-2790 and I can often make it work.

How much does it cost to hang Christmas lights in Saint John?

The same as everywhere I work: $200 for a mini-home or small bungalow, $250 for a bungalow and $350 for a large bungalow or split-level. Two-storey homes get a custom quote. Every job is at least $200.

How do I book in Saint John?

Text your address and a photo of your house to 506-799-2790, or use the quote form. I'll confirm your price, usually within a day, and same-day appointments are available.

Do I have to supply the lights?

That's the idea. Most people already own lights, so I hang yours. If you don't have enough, or don't have any, I can bring them. They're added to your quote and you keep them.

Will it damage my roof or gutters?

No. I use clips made for gutters and shingles. There are no nails, screws or drilling.

Do I need to be home?

No. Leave your lights by the door or in the garage, and make sure I can reach an outdoor outlet. I'll text you a photo when it's done.
